authorizationDecision.subject: Flank Speed IL5 - Microsoft 365 DoD Tenant (Synthetic)
authorizationDecision.scope: Illustrative decision worksheet for SYN-FS-IL5-001, limited to the twelve notional tenant service/operational components and their qualified candidate provider dependencies. It does not authorize a real tenant, Navy mission, external endpoint/network, support service, AI/Copilot service, or unapproved integration. Proposed dates are placeholders and do not imply permission to operate.
conditions: Before any real decision, designate a legitimate authorizing official, approve mission categorization and the full applicable baseline, and obtain an actual independent assessment.
Resolve or explicitly disposition FS-FIND-001 and FS-FIND-005 with applicable evidence and real authority; an invented high-severity POAM schedule is not risk acceptance.
Keep the unbounded guest-sharing proposal restricted until FS-FIND-002 is independently reviewed and authorized exchange conditions are met.
Demonstrate audit source/retention coverage for FS-FIND-003 and supported four-workload recovery for FS-FIND-004, or obtain explicit documented risk treatment from a real authority.
Keep the conflicting retention proposal blocked until FS-FIND-006 has authoritative records/hold resolution, verified technical behavior, and independent change review.
Maintain all six POAMs as Open with empty closureEvidence arrays as of 2026-09-24; future milestones and anticipated artifacts are not submitted or accepted closure.
Require verified service/cloud/SKU availability and authorized-boundary applicability for every optional information-protection, audit, recovery, or privileged-management feature before crediting it.
Apply the monitoring and incident handoff plan only after actual customer authority, contacts, tools, and evidence paths are established; no fixture contact is operational.
exclusions: Real Navy Flank Speed configuration, actual DoD operational data, CUI, classified information, and real identities or credentials.
Customer devices, endpoint-management services, EDR platforms, identity-federation infrastructure outside the tenant, customer networks, and their accreditation boundaries.
Azure subscriptions, virtual machines, IaaS firewalls, Azure Key Vault, and other arbitrary Azure resources; none is represented as a native Microsoft 365 component.
Third-party SaaS, third-party backup, external SIEM platforms, and external recipient systems; only documented tenant-side interfaces are modeled.
Microsoft support service and support-channel data handling, which the public service description places outside the service accreditation boundary.
AI assistants, Microsoft Copilot, AI processing, custom agents, unapproved applications, and application/service-principal integrations.
An issued authorization, real inherited-control attestation, real assessment result, or claim that a notional target is implemented or effective.
